slides.title: Real-Time Search With Native Citations
bullets: Combines language generation with an active internet search at query time
Systematically presents the specific sources behind each claim
Native, reliable citation instead of references to verify separately
Rated among the strongest research tools for academic and medical work

slides.title: Mapping an Unfamiliar Landscape Fast
bullets: Explore what is known today about an emerging therapeutic area
Identify which companies have active development programs on a target
Spot treatment trends gaining traction in the clinical community
Arrive prepared for a first deep dive, with sources to verify later

slides.title: Tracking Scientific and Competitive Updates
bullets: Ask what has been published in the last few weeks on a comparator
Draws on active search instead of a static training cutoff
Keeps landscape awareness current between deep-dive research sessions

slides.title: Source Quality Still Varies
bullets: Citing sources systematically does not guarantee source quality
Mix can include peer-reviewed papers and lower-rigor public content
Apply the Module 6 evidence hierarchy criteria to every citation
Never share a clinical fact with an HCP without checking the original source

takeaway.title: Perplexity is the fastest way to map a topic, but every cited source still needs evaluation
bullets: Best for early, sourced exploration of a new or fast-moving topic
Native citations save time but do not certify source quality
Original source verification remains mandatory before HCP communication
